pay_salary_schedule_001.evidence: Salary matrices (A-1, A-2, A-3, TAN, CSC and BMS) including longevity indices, are subject to review annually. Refer to Appendix A–Salary Matrices

pay_step_increment_003.evidence: Educators may claim eligibility for salary increments, National Board Certification, and bilingual and ESL endorsements by submitting a letter on or before September 15 followed by an official transcript as soon as possible to the Department of Human Resources

pay_prior_experience_005.evidence: Credit on the salary matrix within job classifications shall be given for all years of qualified in-district experience, and all years of qualified out-of-district experience in a licensed educational role shall be credited.
